*HT SELEX \+ Hia5 Checklist*

1. Prepare protein plate same as last round of SELEX  
2. Prepare fresh 1.55X SELEX Buffer Plates  
3. Write *Hia*5 program \[4.5 uL TF dilution buffer \+ 8.5 uL 1.55X SELEX Buffer \+ 5 uL DNA → Incubate 30 mins, RT → 1 uL dHia5 \+ 0.7 uL SAM \+ 4.3 uL Hia5 buffer\]  
4. Test Hia5 activity again with 25 uL reaction  
5. Set up PCR for lig147 and lig70N with PE2/3 plates \- prepare separate mastermix plates for this with PE\_F and PE\_R primers

Post *Hia*5 steps:

- Inactivate *Hia*5 with heating at 80 degrees, 10 mins  
- Pool all DNA \+ PNK treatment \+ ligation 

Test Hia5:

R1: 4.5 uL TF dilution buffer \+ 8.5 uL 1.55X SELEX Buffer \+ 30 ng DNA (1 uL) \+ 1 uL dHia5 \+ 0.7 uL SAM \+ 4.3 uL Hia5 buffer \+ 4 uL H2O

R2: 4.5 uL TF dilution buffer \+ 8.5 uL 1.55X SELEX Buffer \+ 30 ng DNA (1 uL) \+ 0.5 uL dHia5 \+ 0.7 uL SAM \+ 4.3 uL Hia5 buffer \+ 4.5 uL H2O

*Testing DpnI digestion of dam/dcm negative enhancer plasmids*

- pHRS-Gclav1
